# GitHub community configuration

`ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` contains structured bug and feature-request forms plus contact links. Keep issue questions focused on reproducible workflows and safe, redacted evidence.

Update the template index when changing the issue flow. Do not add workflows, automation credentials or permissions unless the repository needs them and their scope has been reviewed.

**For code changes, follow the project coding guidelines** supplied by maintainers and [maintenance rules](../docs/maintenance.md).
